g.text: Each empirical CDF maps a modality-specific time score to its training-fold percentile before fusion,

text.style: font-size: 8px; font-family: 'DejaVu Sans'; text-anchor: start; fill: #62666d

g.text: preserving within-modality order while preventing arbitrary score scales from dominating the patient-level rank.

g.text: At inference, higher q indicates longer predicted survival. A positive monotone Cox-Breslow projection provides full curves without changing C-index.
